title: GH-13 triage: benchmark build failure with modern criterion
description: Make bench1 build reliable on modern criterion and enforce it as a hard CI requirement.
acceptance_criteria: 1) bench/Bench1.hs no longer imports Criterion.Config. 2) bench1 builds successfully on CI and local documented env. 3) CI pipeline fails if bench1 fails. 4) Native dependencies required for bench1 (e.g., snappy/quicklz) are provisioned and documented.
notes: Review result: AC1, AC2, and AC4 are satisfied (Criterion.Config removed; local cabal test properties and cabal build bench1 pass with documented snappy dependency). AC3 is not satisfied yet because .github/workflows/ci.yml has invalid YAML (step 'Install native benchmark dependencies' has mis-indented run block). Verified with ruby YAML parser (Psych::SyntaxError). Next: fix workflow indentation and re-verify CI config parses.

title: GH-12 decision: frame/streaming roadmap and compatibility contract
description: Decision task for GH #12: define API and compatibility policy for streaming/frame support without breaking existing users.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Record explicit compatibility contract: existing compress/decompress semantics remain unchanged. 2) Record scope choice for next implementation slice (framed-only vs full streaming API). 3) Record whether runtime lz4 CLI dependency is acceptable or must be replaced by native bindings. 4) Create/maintain linked implementation task(s) for chosen scope.
notes: Decision recorded: implementation direction is native LZ4F bindings (no runtime lz4 CLI dependency).
close_reason: Decision finalized: native LZ4F bindings; bench1 hard CI; GH #8 closed stale

title: Senior-review remediation: framed API robustness and compatibility
description: Address strict code-review findings on framed API behavior, test coverage, docs consistency, CI rigor, and API quality.
acceptance_criteria: All child tasks in this epic are closed with linked validation evidence; framed API compatibility claims are backed by oracle/conformance tests; no unresolved blockers remain.
notes: Rooted in senior-review findings for this branch.

title: Fix decompression of concatenated LZ4 frames
description: decompressFrame currently rejects valid concatenated frame streams. Align behavior with standard lz4 expectations for multi-frame inputs.
acceptance_criteria: decompressFrame accepts concatenated valid frames and returns concatenated payload output; malformed trailing bytes still fail cleanly; tests cover single-frame and multi-frame cases.
notes: Default behavior: concatenated valid frames decode successfully; any trailing non-frame bytes after complete frame stream are treated as malformed and fail.

title: Add oracle conformance tests via minithesis-hs against CLI tools
description: Build an oracle test suite that compares this library's behavior with command-line tools across generated inputs, especially framed encode/decode paths.
acceptance_criteria: Automated oracle tests run in CI and compare library vs CLI outputs over generated corpora using minithesis-hs. Default oracle commands: lz4 -z and lz4 -d. Any mismatch is a hard CI failure and emits actionable diff artifacts.
notes: Default CI budget: keep oracle suite deterministic and bounded (target <= 90s on ubuntu-latest).

title: Expand regression corpus for LZ4 C code upgrade
description: The large bundled C upgrade needs broader compatibility coverage beyond round-trip happy paths.
acceptance_criteria: Add fixtures/tests for truncated frames, corrupted headers/checksums, concatenated frames, and representative legacy payloads; document expected outcomes per case. Default legacy set: fixtures from pre-frame API behavior and current framed behavior.

title: Align README/cabal metadata with bundled LZ4 sources and CI
description: Remove stale/version-inconsistent docs and metadata now that LZ4F/xxhash sources and new CI checks are present.
acceptance_criteria: README and cabal metadata accurately describe current bundled sources, format support, and CI expectations; stale badges/links are updated or removed.

title: Harden benchmark gate: reproducible local + CI prerequisites
description: bench1 is a hard CI requirement; make dependency provisioning and workflow behavior explicit and non-fragile.
acceptance_criteria: CI benchmark step is deterministic; required native deps are clearly documented for local runs; workflow avoids unnecessary duplicate work while keeping hard-gate semantics. Default scope: hard gate on ubuntu-latest PR/push CI.
notes: Progress: tightened CI benchmark gate command to explicit component build (cabal build --enable-benchmarks lz4:bench:bench1), removed redundant cabal build step, and documented native prerequisites/local CI-equivalent commands in bench/README.md. Verification: cabal test properties PASS; MINITHESIS_NO_DATABASE=1 MINITHESIS_MAX_EXAMPLES=40 cabal test oracle PASS. Blocker: local benchmark build requires system libsnappy (-lsnappy). Attempted install with sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libsnappy-dev lz4 but environment requires interactive sudo password, so benchmark gate could not be completed locally in this session.

title: Add bounded framed decompression path for memory safety
description: Current strict framed decode path can allocate unbounded output. Provide a bounded/streaming-safe option and document tradeoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Expose bounded framed decompression with streaming partial-output semantics and explicit continuation/failure contract. Preserve existing unbounded API. Define behavior for limit breaches and malformed input, including resumability/termination guarantees, and cover with tests.
notes: Decision locked: bounded path should support streaming partial-output semantics rather than strict fail-atomic only.

title: Improve framed API error reporting
description: Current Maybe-based framed API drops error context, making debugging and support difficult.
acceptance_criteria: Define and ship a stable public framed-error API contract (semver-sensitive) for encode/decode. Provide typed errors with documented invariants, backward-compatible Maybe wrappers, and tests covering representative error classes and mapping stability.
notes: Decision locked: framed error type is a stable public API contract; future changes require semver discipline and migration notes.

title: GH-10 triage: incompatibility with stock lz4 framed files
description: Triage recommendation: KEEP OPEN. Reproduced: data compressed by system lz4 CLI fails to decompress via Codec.Compression.LZ4.decompress (returns Nothing). Current format is library-specific length-prefixed framing and is not wire-compatible with standard LZ4 frame files. Any fix likely requires additive API to avoid breaking current users.
